entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim; a shadowy realm of towering trees and peat bogs, home to the elves.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane containing ten realms, including Skemfar.

entities.name: Elves of Skemfar
entities.description: Distant descendants of the Einir who live in Skemfar; wood elves and shadow elves are reunited under a new king.

entities.name: Jaspera Trees
entities.description: Seven towering trees that serve as prisons where the Skoti bound the surviving Einir leaders; the elves revere them.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The elves' divine ancestors, defeated by the Skoti; their surviving leaders are imprisoned in the Jaspera trees.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The gods of the current age, who defeated the Einir and forbade Koma from entering any realm.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: King of the elves who claims to have received a vision of a united elf dynasty from a Jaspera tree's fruit.

entities.name: Jormund
entities.description: The largest elf settlement, an ancient city built when the elves were gods; Harthhall is at its heart.

entities.name: Harthhall
entities.description: Newly built home of the King at the heart of Jormund.

entities.name: Serpent Tunnels
entities.description: Network of tunnels left by Koma that the elves hold sacred.

entities.name: Koma, Cosmos Serpent
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent revered by the elves, forbidden by the Skoti from entering any realm.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion for which Skemfar was a major site.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm whose Kirda Sea is linked to Skemfar by an omenpath.

entities.name: Kirda Sea
entities.description: Sea in Bretagard connected by an omenpath to Skemfar.

events.summary: The Skoti imprison the surviving Einir leaders in the Jaspera trees as a warning.
events.quote: said to be prisons where the Skoti imprisoned the surviving leaders of the Einir

events.summary: Harald eats a Jaspera fruit, sleeps beneath its boughs, and claims a vision of a united elf dynasty.
events.quote: claims to have received a vision of a united elf dynasty

events.summary: An omenpath opens to the Kirda Sea during the New Phyrexian Invasion, spawning a new river in Skemfar.
events.quote: Skemfar was a major site of the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: Skemfar is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim
about the Skoti defeating the Einir

relations.note: the Skoti forbade Koma from entering any realm
relations.quote: have forbidden him from entering any of the realms
